heroes.dev_note: 开发者评论：“微型飞弹”搭配提供的伤害输出既高又持久，不论是爆发伤害还是长时间战斗中的表现都超出了预期。本次更新对其进行了削弱，让它与其他搭配选项的水准齐平，同时又保留了这套搭配的核心打法和影响力。

lines_cn: 要求抵挡的伤害从100提高到150。

heroes.dev_note: 开发者评论：弗蕾娅的“流星索”搭配表现一直不够给力，特别是与弗蕾娅有统治级表现的武器强度流搭配相比。我们决定提升相关异能的威力，增强弗蕾娅的搭配多样化。

lines_cn: 持续时间从2秒延长至3秒。

heroes.dev_note: 开发者评论：“减速雪球”干扰敌人的效果非常优秀，但减速效果不仅过于强大，且十分容易施加。我们决定削弱减速的效果，使其不那么具有压倒性优势，但当美进行精确射击和巧妙使用辅助攻击模式时，依然能达到非常不错的效果。
开发者评论：对于强调暴击的搭配来说，“医疗精锐”的效果并没能达到预期。本次增强主要是提升这个异能的暴击倍率，让精确操作的收益更大，也是对高端玩家的高风险高回报玩法风格的重大回馈。

old.title: Gameplay Sabotage Detection
old.body:
We're improving our tools to combat gameplay sabotage in Overwatch. We have made improvements to our current detection tools that allow us to more accurately detect players engaging in disruptive behaviors, and we've already taken action against many players detected by these systems. Examples of gameplay sabotage include consistently and intentionally failing to contribute to team fights, repeatedly jumping off the map, and intentionally blocking team progress. We will also continue to iterate on these detection methods so that we can catch even more players who are intentionally making other players' experiences worse.

As part of this update, we have also rolled out 'Thank You' messages for reporting a player for disruptive behaviors. You will see these show up in the game's Notification Hub if you report a player for disruptive behaviors, and appropriate actions have been taken against them.

diff.new: The Excavation Initiative is back from 11/3-12/7 with some changes! You'll earn Loot Boxes by logging in and winning a game. Do this multiple weeks to earn rewards - Base, Epic, and Legendary Loot Boxes await those who complete the challenges.

old.dev_note: Developer Comments: Power Barrier’s changes are intended to make deploying the barrier more of a commitment and improve its readability for enemies. Propulsors will retain its knockback while no longer dealing impact damage, reducing Dmon’s burst potential. Overstrike’s lifesteal is also being reduced to limit the total health it can provide.

changes.text_en: Recovery increased from 0.2 to 0.3 seconds.
Now has a 0.25 second minimum deploy duration.
Impact damage reduced from 15 to 0.

old.dev_note: Developer Comments: Junker Queen’s lower health pool can limit her ability to engage when she’s unable to apply Wounds and benefit from their healing. Increasing her base health improves her survivability, while reducing Carnage’s cooldown provides more opportunities to use it when enemies are within range.

changes.text_en: Added a new UI element that tracks allies within range and allies currently affected by Commanding Shout.
Cooldown reduced from 9 to 7 seconds.

old.dev_note: Developer Comments: Recent changes to Mauga have reduced his overall effectiveness, with his win rate falling below acceptable bounds. Restoring some of his base armor improves his survivability, while increasing his burning damage rewards igniting enemies without placing additional emphasis on enemy Tanks.

changes.text_en: Burning damage over time increased from 15 to 20.

old.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing Void Accelerator’s ammo improves Ramattra’s ability to apply sustained pressure at range while outside of Nemesis Form.

changes.text_en: Ammo increased from 100 to 125.

old.dev_note: Developer Comments: Recent changes to hitboxes and projectile sizes have reduced Reaper’s overall effectiveness. Increasing his base health improves his survivability and helps compensate for these changes.
